name: proto-include-root-holds-only-its-copies
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the import roots are buf's for a directory with no buf.yaml, the target root, besides the include roots of upstream copies: the include root of an upstream copy holds that copy alone, so an import of another schema file below it by its path from that directory resolves under no root, and the importer publishes nothing and carries an unresolved-import note, while the imported file and the copy are published under their own paths. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
